fusions.name: Pincushion
fusions.desc: Throws a threaded needle at the first enemy it meets for 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rug from Under
fusions.desc: Yanks the ground cover out from under everything in a cone 3 tiles deep, dealing 11 damage and stunning each target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Field Dressing
fusions.desc: Binds your wounds, restoring 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Kid Gloves
fusions.desc: Conjures a pair of fitted gloves: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, and each kill returns 3 health.
